foundationscrisis.name: Foundations Crisis: The Limits of Formalization
foundationscrisis.truth: Different formal systems and representations have different powers and limits. Investigate their assumptions before generalising.
foundationscrisis.qfep_connection: The sequence supplies questions for Ada’s QFEP research proposal. Geometry, incompleteness, construction and non-explosion do not prove that proposal or a universal need for chaos.
foundationscrisis.formula: QFE = F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t) — the synthesis presents this as a project proposal.
foundationscrisis.description: Eight encounters with assumptions, membership, proof, projection, construction and conflicting reports. The final hall asks what a model accounts for and who can answer back.
learning_objectives: Compare Euclidean and non-Euclidean choices of geometry.
Distinguish unrestricted comprehension from self-reference alone.
Understand incompleteness as a result about specified arithmetic theories.
Compare constructive evidence, unresolved claims and non-explosion.
Question how a research model selects, measures and values its states.
content: Euclid_Parallel: What is assumed about parallel lines?
NonEuclidean_Spaces: What changes with the geometry?
Russell_Paradox: Which membership demand produces the contradiction?
Godel_Incompleteness: What can this theory prove?
Escher_Impossible: What does the convincing view conceal?
Florensky_Paraconsistent: What follows from conflicting reports?
Crisis_Synthesis: Who can answer the model?

deferred_reason.Chamber_Foundations: chambers removed from the spine (Palle, 2026-09-02): the catalyst chambers leave the walk; the map stays on disk

artifact_groups.rationale: One postulates plaque has lesson_controls:on; the triangle and parallel-lines studies distinguish declarations from measurements. The screen is a grid display.

The triangle bench starts at PLANE and compares plane, sphere and disk using model-specific edge tangents. The separate slider only changes its own sketch; the saddle is not a constant-curvature hyperbolic metric.

Seven placed artifacts replace the old single-box record. The workbench has membership_controls:on and initial_cell:5; IN/OUT tests lead to the restricted finite domain. The returning plaque keeps independence distinct from contradiction.

Ten placements include the sentence machine, verifier and regress comparisons, plaque, provability sorter and tower. The final distinguishes a bounded search from an unprovability theorem; the old island/plaque-only record is obsolete.

STEP reads tread-centre heights with lesson_controls:on. Closed routes balance ascent/descent; OPEN RUN and SCAFFOLD stop before closing; TILTED TREADS has level centres. The Penrose study tracks the viewer.

visitor_choices:on enables a finite 0/1 prefix; the diagonal bench constructs an inspectable finite witness. Timed stairs and supplied geometry remain comparisons, not hand-built proofs or general proof checkers.

The gate has report_controls:on; OPEN and CLOSED persist independently while Q has no support. The sphere has hold_both:on. The box uses a desktop-only random opening and the opacity display has no measurement operation.

Eleven placements include reading_study:on, dispute-calibrated lambda/phi rails, an independent visitor-controlled logistic r starting at 3.2, the recursive atrium and sentence-authority study. Brouwer’s bench is recalled from its hall; there is no placed constructive wing or four-visit summit gate.

application_studies.sentence_authority: Change one sentence once; follow the same words across label, strip and wall.
